name: SG1120-1202 group 2 (Hubble)
blurb: SG1120-1202 group 2, one of four galaxy groups in a supergroup, seen by Hubble.
label: sg112012022-hubble
story: One of four galaxy groups in the supergroup SG1120-1202, which will merge to form a cluster comparable in mass to Coma; Hubble looked here for the faint light of stars that drift between the galaxies.

claims.text: It is composed of four galaxy groups that will merge to form a cluster comparable in mass to Coma
